snippet.title: Holotrials: Case Covered - Official Game Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST ON STEAM
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4252960/HoloTrials_Case_Covered/

A graffiti mocking the Student Council President appears on the walls, and your best friend is the prime suspect! Play as a student detective in HoloTrials: Case Covered. Investigate the high school campus, face off against your rivals, and clear her name in this legal mystery.

HoloTrials is a Free Mystery Visual Novel game!
